          key: dealer.k,
          label: `${dealer.nome} · BIR ${dealer.bir || '-'}`,
          search: normalize(`${dealer.nome} ${dealer.bir || ''}`),
        }));
    const populate = () => {
      options = optionData(typeSelect.value);
      const html = options.map(option => `<option value="${escapeHtml(option.label)}"></option>`).join('');
      leftList.innerHTML = html;
      rightList.innerHTML = html;
      leftInput.value = '';
      rightInput.value = '';
      swapButton.disabled = true;
      copyButton.disabled = true;
      result.className = 'dealerx-empty comparison-empty';
      result.innerHTML = `<strong>Escolha ${typeSelect.value === 'group' ? 'um grupo' : 'uma concessionária'} para começar.</strong><span>A pesquisa aceita nome ou BIR.</span>`;
    };
    const resolveOption = input => {
      const query = normalize(input.value);
      if (!query) return { key: '', option: null, ambiguous: false };
      const exact = options.find(option => normalize(option.label) === query || normalize(option.key) === query);
      if (exact) return { key: exact.key, option: exact, ambiguous: false };
      const matches = options.filter(option => option.search.includes(query));
      return matches.length === 1
        ? { key: matches[0].key, option: matches[0], ambiguous: false }
        : { key: '', option: null, ambiguous: matches.length > 1 };
    };
    const entityItems = (type, key, channel) => {
      if (!key) return [];
      return dealers.filter(dealer => dealer.canais?.[channel] && (
        type === 'group'
          ? canonicalGroup(dealer.canais[channel].grupo) === key
          : dealer.k === key
      ));
    };
    const deltaText = (kpi, left, right) => {
      if (left == null || right == null) return '-';
      const difference = Number(left) - Number(right);
      const sign = difference > 0 ? '+' : '';
      if (['quantidade', 'emails_enviados', 'emails_entregues', 'quantidade_retorno'].includes(kpi)) {
        return `${sign}${Math.round(difference).toLocaleString('pt-BR')}`;
      }
      if (['estrelas', 'nota_test_drive'].includes(kpi)) return `${sign}${difference.toFixed(2).replace('.', ',')}`;
      return `${sign}${difference.toFixed(2).replace('.', ',')} p.p.`;
    };
    const deltaClass = (channel, kpi, left, right) => {
      if (left == null || right == null || Number(left) === Number(right)) return 'neutral';
      const lowerIsBetter = (data.canais?.[channel]?.menor_melhor || []).includes(kpi);
      const leftIsBetter = lowerIsBetter ? Number(left) < Number(right) : Number(left) > Number(right);
      return leftIsBetter ? 'good' : 'bad';
    };
    const barWidth = (value, kpi, peer) => {
      if (value == null) return 0;
      if (['quantidade', 'emails_enviados', 'emails_entregues', 'quantidade_retorno'].includes(kpi)) {
        return Math.max(4, Math.min(100, Number(value) / Math.max(1, Number(value), Number(peer || 0)) * 100));
      }
      if (['estrelas', 'nota_test_drive'].includes(kpi)) return Math.max(0, Math.min(100, Number(value) / 5 * 100));
      if (kpi.startsWith('nps_')) return Math.max(0, Math.min(100, (Number(value) + 100) / 2));
      return Math.max(0, Math.min(100, Number(value)));
    };
    const comparisonCard = (channel, kpi, label, leftValue, rightValue, hasRight) => `
      <article class="comparison-kpi-card">
        <div class="comparison-kpi-head"><span>${escapeHtml(label)}</span>${hasRight ? `<strong class="comparison-delta ${deltaClass(channel, kpi, leftValue, rightValue)}">${deltaText(kpi, leftValue, rightValue)}</strong>` : ''}</div>
        <div class="comparison-measure"><span>A</span><strong class="${objectiveClass(channel, kpi, leftValue)}">${formatValue(leftValue, kpi)}</strong><i><b style="--comparison-width:${barWidth(leftValue, kpi, rightValue)}%"></b></i></div>
        ${hasRight ? `<div class="comparison-measure secondary-measure"><span>B</span><strong class="${objectiveClass(channel, kpi, rightValue)}">${formatValue(rightValue, kpi)}</strong><i><b style="--comparison-width:${barWidth(rightValue, kpi, leftValue)}%"></b></i></div>` : ''}
      </article>`;

    const render = () => {
      const type = typeSelect.value;
      const left = resolveOption(leftInput);
      const right = resolveOption(rightInput);
      if (!left.key) {
        result.className = 'dealerx-empty comparison-empty';
        result.innerHTML = `<strong>${left.ambiguous ? 'Há mais de um resultado com esse texto.' : 'Selecione um resultado A válido.'}</strong><span>${left.ambiguous ? 'Digite mais detalhes do nome ou o BIR.' : 'Use a pesquisa para localizar a unidade ou o grupo.'}</span>`;
        copyButton.disabled = true;
        return;
      }
      if (rightInput.value.trim() && !right.key) {
        result.className = 'dealerx-empty comparison-empty';
        result.innerHTML = `<strong>${right.ambiguous ? 'O resultado B está ambíguo.' : 'O resultado B não foi encontrado.'}</strong><span>Refine o nome ou apague o campo para analisar apenas A.</span>`;
        copyButton.disabled = true;
        return;
      }
      const hasRight = Boolean(right.key);
      if (left.option) leftInput.value = left.option.label;
      if (right.option) rightInput.value = right.option.label;
      swapButton.disabled = !hasRight;
      const leftName = left.option?.label || left.key;
      const rightName = right.option?.label || right.key;
      const keyMetrics = ['nps_index', 'quantidade', 'taxa_resposta', 'data_quality'];
      const channelBlocks = ['vn', 'pv'].map(channel => {
        const leftItems = entityItems(type, left.key, channel);
        const rightItems = entityItems(type, right.key, channel);
        const leftValue = aggregateValues(leftItems, channel, keys);
        const rightValue = hasRight ? aggregateValues(rightItems, channel, keys) : {};
        const metadata = data.canais[channel] || {};
        const kpis = metadata.kpis || [];
        const comparable = kpis.filter(kpi => metadata.objetivos?.[kpi] != null
          && leftValue[kpi] != null && rightValue[kpi] != null);
        let leftWins = 0;
        let rightWins = 0;
        let ties = 0;
        comparable.forEach(kpi => {
          if (Number(leftValue[kpi]) === Number(rightValue[kpi])) ties += 1;
          else if (deltaClass(channel, kpi, leftValue[kpi], rightValue[kpi]) === 'good') leftWins += 1;
          else rightWins += 1;
        });
        const insight = hasRight
          ? `A lidera em ${leftWins} indicador${leftWins === 1 ? '' : 'es'}; B em ${rightWins}; ${ties} empate${ties === 1 ? '' : 's'}.`
          : 'Resultado individual com cores comparadas às metas do canal.';
        const cards = keyMetrics.filter(kpi => kpis.includes(kpi)).map(kpi => comparisonCard(
          channel,
          kpi,
          metadata.rotulos?.[kpi] || kpi,
          leftValue[kpi],
          rightValue[kpi],
          hasRight,
        )).join('');
        const rows = kpis.map(kpi => `<tr><td class="name">${escapeHtml(metadata.rotulos?.[kpi] || kpi)}</td><td class="${objectiveClass(channel, kpi, leftValue[kpi])}">${formatValue(leftValue[kpi], kpi)}</td>${hasRight ? `<td class="${objectiveClass(channel, kpi, rightValue[kpi])}">${formatValue(rightValue[kpi], kpi)}</td><td class="${deltaClass(channel, kpi, leftValue[kpi], rightValue[kpi])}">${deltaText(kpi, leftValue[kpi], rightValue[kpi])}</td>` : ''}</tr>`).join('');
        return `<section class="comparison-channel-card channel-${channel}"><div class="dealerx-title ${channel}"><span>${channel === 'vn' ? 'Vendas' : 'Pós-Venda'}</span><small>${escapeHtml(activePeriod.toUpperCase())}</small></div><p class="comparison-insight">${escapeHtml(insight)}</p><div class="comparison-kpi-grid">${cards}</div><details class="comparison-details"><summary>Ver todos os indicadores</summary><div class="dealerx-scroll"><table class="dealerx-table comparison-table"><thead><tr><th>Indicador</th><th>Resultado A</th>${hasRight ? '<th>Resultado B</th><th>Diferença A − B</th>' : ''}</tr></thead><tbody>${rows}</tbody></table></div></details></section>`;
      }).join('');
      result.className = 'dealerx-comparison-result';
      result.innerHTML = `<div class="comparison-hero"><article class="comparison-entity-card entity-a"><span>Resultado A</span><strong>${escapeHtml(leftName)}</strong></article><div class="comparison-versus">${hasRight ? 'versus' : 'análise'}</div>${hasRight ? `<article class="comparison-entity-card entity-b"><span>Resultado B</span><strong>${escapeHtml(rightName)}</strong></article>` : `<article class="comparison-entity-card entity-period"><span>Período</span><strong>${escapeHtml(activePeriod.toUpperCase())}</strong></article>`}</div><div class="comparison-channel-grid">${channelBlocks}</div>`;
      copyButton.disabled = false;
    };

    const copyComparison = async () => {
      const tables = [...result.querySelectorAll('.comparison-table')];
      if (!tables.length) return;
      const original = copyButton.textContent;
      const text = tables.map(table => tableText(table)).join('\n\n');
      const html = `<meta charset="utf-8">${tables.map(table => `<table border="1" style="border-collapse:collapse;font-family:Calibri,Arial,sans-serif">${table.innerHTML}</table>`).join('<br>')}`;
      try {
        if (navigator.clipboard?.write && typeof ClipboardItem === 'function') {
          await navigator.clipboard.write([new ClipboardItem({
            'text/html': new Blob([html], { type: 'text/html' }),
            'text/plain': new Blob([text], { type: 'text/plain' }),
          })]);
        } else if (navigator.clipboard?.writeText) await navigator.clipboard.writeText(text);
        else throw new Error('Cópia não suportada');
        copyButton.textContent = 'Comparativo copiado';
      } catch (_) {
        copyButton.textContent = 'Cópia bloqueada';
      }
      setTimeout(() => { copyButton.textContent = original; }, 1600);
    };

    typeSelect.addEventListener('change', populate);
    pane.querySelector('[data-compare-go]').addEventListener('click', render);
    [leftInput, rightInput].forEach(input => input.addEventListener('keydown', event => {
      if (event.key === 'Enter') render();
    }));
    swapButton.addEventListener('click', () => {
      const previousLeft = leftInput.value;
      leftInput.value = rightInput.value;
      rightInput.value = previousLeft;
      render();
    });
    copyButton.addEventListener('click', copyComparison);
    pane.querySelectorAll('[data-compare-period]').forEach(button => button.addEventListener('click', () => {
      activePeriod = button.dataset.comparePeriod;
      keys = presetMonthKeys(activePeriod);
      pane.querySelectorAll('[data-compare-period]').forEach(item => item.classList.toggle('active', item === button));
      pane.querySelector('[data-compare-period-label]').textContent = `${activePeriod.toUpperCase()} · ${periodDescription(keys)}`;
      if (leftInput.value.trim()) render();
    }));
    populate();
  }

  setupEntityComparisonV2();
}, 0);

(() => {
  const $ = (id) => document.getElementById(id);
  const loading = $('serverLoading');
  const message = $('serverMessage');

  function storageGet(key) {
    try { return window.sessionStorage.getItem(key); } catch (_) { return null; }
  }

  function storageSet(key, value) {
    try { window.sessionStorage.setItem(key, value); } catch (_) {}
  }

  function showLoading(show) {
    if (loading) loading.classList.toggle('active', Boolean(show));
  }

  function setMessage(text, type = '') {
    if (!message) return;
    message.textContent = text || '';
    message.className = `server-message${type ? ` ${type}` : ''}`;
  }

  function switchMainTab(target, button) {
    document.querySelectorAll('.dashboard-section').forEach(section => {
      section.classList.toggle('active', section.id === target);
    });
    document.querySelectorAll('[data-tab-target]').forEach(tab => {
      const active = tab === button;
      tab.classList.toggle('active', active);
      if (active) tab.setAttribute('aria-current', 'page');
      else tab.removeAttribute('aria-current');
    });
    storageSet('geely.activeSection', target);
    try { window.scrollTo({ top: 82, behavior: 'smooth' }); }
    catch (_) { window.scrollTo(0, 82); }
    try { button?.scrollIntoView({ behavior: 'smooth', block: 'nearest', inline: 'center' }); }
    catch (_) {}
  }

  document.querySelectorAll('[data-tab-target]').forEach(button => {
    button.addEventListener('click', event => {
      event.preventDefault();
      switchMainTab(button.dataset.tabTarget, button);
    });
  });

  const hashTab = (window.location.hash || '').replace(/^#/, '');
  const savedTab = hashTab || storageGet('geely.activeSection');
  if (savedTab) {
    const button = [...document.querySelectorAll('[data-tab-target]')]
      .find(tab => tab.dataset.tabTarget === savedTab);
    if (button) switchMainTab(savedTab, button);
  }
  document.documentElement.classList.remove('no-js');
  document.documentElement.classList.add('js-ready');

  function activatePanel(kind, target) {
    document.querySelectorAll(`[data-${kind}-panel]`).forEach(panel => {
      panel.classList.toggle('active', panel.dataset[`${kind}Panel`] === target);
    });
    document.querySelectorAll(`[data-${kind}-target]`).forEach(button => {
      button.classList.toggle('active', button.dataset[`${kind}Target`] === target);
    });
  }

  document.querySelectorAll('[data-ranking-target]').forEach(button => {
    button.addEventListener('click', event => {
      event.preventDefault();
      activatePanel('ranking', button.dataset.rankingTarget);
    });
  });
  activatePanel('ranking', 'vn');

  const rankingSearch = $('rankingDealerSearch');
  const rankingChoices = [...document.querySelectorAll('[data-ranking-dealer-choice]')];
  const rankingClear = document.querySelector('[data-ranking-filter-clear]');
  const rankingSelection = $('rankingDealerSelection');
  const rankingFilter = document.querySelector('[data-ranking-filter]');
  const rankingToggle = document.querySelector('[data-ranking-filter-toggle]');

  function setRankingMenu(open) {
    if (!rankingFilter || !rankingToggle) return;
    rankingFilter.classList.toggle('open', open);
    rankingToggle.setAttribute('aria-expanded', String(open));
    if (open) rankingSearch?.focus();
  }

  function normalizeSearch(value) {
    const text = String(value || '');
    const normalized = typeof text.normalize === 'function' ? text.normalize('NFD') : text;
    return normalized.replace(/[\u0300-\u036f]/g, '').toLowerCase().trim();
  }

  function filterRankingOptions() {
    const search = normalizeSearch(rankingSearch?.value);
    let visible = 0;
    document.querySelectorAll('[data-ranking-dealer-option]').forEach(option => {
      const show = !search || (option.dataset.search || '').includes(search);
      option.classList.toggle('hidden', !show);
      if (show) visible += 1;
    });
    document.querySelector('[data-ranking-dealer-no-results]')?.classList.toggle('hidden', visible > 0);
  }

  function filterRankingRows() {
    const selected = new Set(rankingChoices.filter(choice => choice.checked).map(choice => choice.value));
    const hasSelection = selected.size > 0;
    document.querySelectorAll('[data-ranking-panel]').forEach(panel => {
      let visible = 0;
      const rows = panel.querySelectorAll('tr[data-ranking-dealer]');
      rows.forEach(row => {
        const show = !hasSelection || selected.has(row.dataset.rankingDealer);
        row.classList.toggle('hidden', !show);
        if (show) visible += 1;
      });
      panel.querySelector('[data-ranking-filter-empty]')?.classList.toggle('hidden', rows.length === 0 || visible > 0);
    });
    if (rankingSelection) {
      rankingSelection.textContent = hasSelection
        ? `${selected.size} concessionária${selected.size === 1 ? '' : 's'} selecionada${selected.size === 1 ? '' : 's'}`
        : 'Exibindo todas as concessionárias';
    }
    rankingClear?.classList.toggle('hidden', !hasSelection);
  }

  function canvasToBlob(canvas) {
    return new Promise((resolve, reject) => canvas.toBlob(blob => {
      if (blob) resolve(blob);
      else reject(new Error('Não foi possível gerar a imagem.'));
    }, 'image/png'));
  }

  function downloadBlob(blob, fileName) {
    if (!blob?.size) throw new Error('O arquivo gerado está vazio.');
    const url = URL.createObjectURL(blob);
    const link = document.createElement('a');
    link.href = url;
    link.download = fileName;
    link.rel = 'noopener';
    document.body.appendChild(link);
    link.click();
    link.remove();
    setTimeout(() => URL.revokeObjectURL(url), 5000);
  }

  function shareableFile(blob, fileName) {
    if (typeof File !== 'function') return null;
    try { return new File([blob], fileName, { type: blob.type || 'application/octet-stream' }); }
    catch (_) { return null; }
  }

  function canShareFile(file) {
    if (!file || !navigator.share) return false;
    if (typeof navigator.canShare !== 'function') return true;
    try { return navigator.canShare({ files: [file] }); }
    catch (_) { return false; }
  }

  async function copyImageBlob(blob) {
    if (!navigator.clipboard?.write || typeof ClipboardItem !== 'function') {
      throw new Error('A cópia automática de imagens não está disponível neste navegador.');
    }
    await navigator.clipboard.write([new ClipboardItem({ 'image/png': blob })]);
  }

  let activeImagePreviewCleanup = null;
  function showImageCopyFallback(blob) {
    activeImagePreviewCleanup?.();
    const imageUrl = URL.createObjectURL(blob);
    const overlay = document.createElement('div');
    overlay.className = 'image-copy-preview';
    overlay.setAttribute('role', 'dialog');
    overlay.setAttribute('aria-modal', 'true');
    overlay.setAttribute('aria-labelledby', 'imageCopyPreviewTitle');
    overlay.innerHTML = `
      <div class="image-copy-preview-card">
        <div class="image-copy-preview-head">
          <div>
            <strong id="imageCopyPreviewTitle">Imagem pronta para copiar</strong>
            <small>O navegador bloqueou a cópia automática.</small>
          </div>
          <button type="button" class="image-copy-preview-close" aria-label="Fechar">×</button>
        </div>
        <p>Clique em “Tentar copiar novamente”. Se o bloqueio continuar, clique com o botão direito na imagem (ou pressione e segure no celular) e escolha copiar.</p>
        <div class="image-copy-preview-canvas"><img alt="Prévia da imagem gerada"></div>
        <div class="image-copy-preview-actions">
          <span role="status" aria-live="polite"></span>
          <button type="button" class="export" data-image-copy-retry>Tentar copiar novamente</button>
        </div>
      </div>`;
    overlay.querySelector('img').src = imageUrl;
    document.body.appendChild(overlay);

    const onKeyDown = event => {
      if (event.key === 'Escape') cleanup();
    };
    const cleanup = () => {
      document.removeEventListener('keydown', onKeyDown);
      overlay.remove();
      URL.revokeObjectURL(imageUrl);
      if (activeImagePreviewCleanup === cleanup) activeImagePreviewCleanup = null;
    };
    activeImagePreviewCleanup = cleanup;
    document.addEventListener('keydown', onKeyDown);
    overlay.querySelector('.image-copy-preview-close').addEventListener('click', cleanup);
    overlay.addEventListener('click', event => {
      if (event.target === overlay) cleanup();
    });
    overlay.querySelector('[data-image-copy-retry]').addEventListener('click', async event => {
      const button = event.currentTarget;
      const status = overlay.querySelector('[role="status"]');
      try {
        button.disabled = true;
        button.textContent = 'Copiando...';
        await copyImageBlob(blob);
        status.className = 'success';
        status.textContent = 'Imagem copiada. Use Ctrl+V para colar.';
        button.textContent = 'Imagem copiada';
        setTimeout(cleanup, 1000);
      } catch (_) {
        status.className = 'error';
        status.textContent = 'A cópia ainda está bloqueada. Copie pela própria imagem acima.';
        button.textContent = 'Tentar copiar novamente';
        button.disabled = false;
      }
    });
    overlay.querySelector('[data-image-copy-retry]').focus();
  }

  async function distributeGeneratedImage(generateBlob, fileName, options = {}) {
    const blob = await generateBlob();

    if (options.clipboardOnly) {
      try {
        await copyImageBlob(blob);
        return 'copied';
      } catch (_) {
        showImageCopyFallback(blob);
        return 'previewed';
      }
    }

    const file = shareableFile(blob, fileName);
    const mobile = /Android|iPhone|iPad|iPod/i.test(navigator.userAgent || '');

    if (mobile && canShareFile(file)) {
      try {
        await navigator.share({ files: [file], title: 'Dashboard de Qualidade Geely' });
        return 'shared';
      } catch (error) {
        if (error?.name === 'AbortError') return 'cancelled';
      }
    }

    if (options.preferDownload) {
      downloadBlob(blob, fileName);
      return 'downloaded';
    }

    if (navigator.clipboard && window.ClipboardItem) {
      try {
        await copyImageBlob(blob);
        return 'copied';
      } catch (_) {
        // Mantém compartilhamento ou download como alternativa.
      }
    }

    if (canShareFile(file)) {
      try {
        await navigator.share({ files: [file], title: 'Dashboard de Qualidade Geely' });
        return 'shared';
      } catch (error) {
        if (error?.name === 'AbortError') return 'cancelled';
      }
    }

    downloadBlob(blob, fileName);
    return 'downloaded';
  }

  window.geelyImageTools = { canvasToBlob, distributeGeneratedImage };

  const summaryImageDataElement = document.getElementById('summaryImageData');
  const summaryImageButton = document.querySelector('[data-summary-image]');
  const summaryImageStatus = document.querySelector('[data-summary-image-status]');
  let summaryImageData = null;
  try { summaryImageData = JSON.parse(summaryImageDataElement?.textContent || 'null'); }
  catch (_) { summaryImageData = null; }

  function fitSummaryCanvasText(context, value, maxWidth) {
    const text = String(value ?? '-');
    if (context.measureText(text).width <= maxWidth) return text;
    let shortened = text;
    while (shortened.length && context.measureText(`${shortened}…`).width > maxWidth) shortened = shortened.slice(0, -1);
    return `${shortened}…`;
  }

  function summaryValue(value, kpi) {
    if (value == null || Number.isNaN(value)) return '-';
    if (kpi === 'quantidade') return Math.round(value).toLocaleString('pt-BR');
    if (['estrelas', 'nota_test_drive'].includes(kpi)) return Number(value).toFixed(2).replace('.', ',');
    return `${Number(value).toFixed(2).replace('.', ',')}%`;
  }

  function summaryValueStatus(channel, kpi, value) {
    const objective = summaryImageData?.objetivos?.[channel]?.[kpi];
    if (value == null || Number.isNaN(value) || objective == null) return 'neutral';
    const lowerIsBetter = (summaryImageData.menor_melhor || []).includes(kpi);
    return (lowerIsBetter ? value <= objective : value >= objective) ? 'good' : 'bad';
  }

  function summaryMetricLabel(channel, kpi) {
    const label = summaryImageData.rotulos?.[channel]?.[kpi] || kpi;
    const objective = summaryImageData.objetivos?.[channel]?.[kpi];
    const displayLabel = /^q[123]$/.test(kpi) ? `MOT · ${label}` : label;
    return objective == null ? displayLabel : `${displayLabel} · Obj. ${summaryValue(objective, kpi)}`;
  }

  function summaryBrazilRegionsImage() {
    if (!summaryImageData?.geografias?.length) throw new Error('Não há informações para montar o resumo.');
    const periods = ['mtd', 'ytd'];
    const periodNames = { mtd: 'MTD', ytd: 'YTD' };
    const width = 1500;
    const margin = 24;
    const channelGap = 20;
    const channelWidth = (width - margin * 2 - channelGap) / 2;
    const metricWidth = 420;
    const periodWidth = (channelWidth - metricWidth) / periods.length;
    const titleHeight = 94;
    const geographyTitleHeight = 36;
    const channelTitleHeight = 36;
    const columnHeaderHeight = 30;
    const rowHeight = 32;
    const channelRows = Math.max(
      summaryImageData.kpis?.vn?.length || 0,
      summaryImageData.kpis?.pv?.length || 0,
    );
    const channelHeight = channelTitleHeight + columnHeaderHeight + channelRows * rowHeight;
    const geographyGap = 18;
    const geographyHeight = geographyTitleHeight + channelHeight + geographyGap;
    const legendHeight = 40;
    const height = titleHeight + summaryImageData.geografias.length * geographyHeight + legendHeight;
    const scale = height <= 14000 ? 2 : 1;
    const canvas = document.createElement('canvas');
    canvas.width = width * scale;
    canvas.height = height * scale;
    const context = canvas.getContext('2d');
    if (!context) throw new Error('O navegador não conseguiu preparar a imagem.');
    context.scale(scale, scale);
    context.fillStyle = '#f3f7f9';
    context.fillRect(0, 0, width, height);

    context.fillStyle = '#071e2a';
    context.fillRect(0, 0, width, titleHeight);
    context.fillStyle = '#ffffff';
    context.font = '800 26px Arial, sans-serif';
    context.fillText('Resumo Brasil e Regiões', margin, 36);
    const periodText = periods.map(period => `${periodNames[period]}: ${summaryImageData.periodos?.[period] || '-'}`).join(' · ');
    context.fillStyle = 'rgba(255,255,255,.78)';
    context.font = '700 13px Arial, sans-serif';
    context.fillText(
      fitSummaryCanvasText(context, `Data do relatório: ${summaryImageData.data_relatorio} · ${periodText}`, width - margin * 2),
      margin,
      65,
    );

    summaryImageData.geografias.forEach((geography, geographyIndex) => {
      const top = titleHeight + geographyIndex * geographyHeight;
      const isBrazil = geographyIndex === 0;
      context.fillStyle = isBrazil ? '#ddeff7' : '#e8eef1';
      context.fillRect(margin, top, width - margin * 2, geographyTitleHeight);
      context.fillStyle = isBrazil ? '#004a73' : '#17242b';
      context.font = '800 16px Arial, sans-serif';
      context.fillText(geography.nome, margin + 12, top + 24);

      ['vn', 'pv'].forEach((channel, channelIndex) => {
        const channelX = margin + channelIndex * (channelWidth + channelGap);
        const channelY = top + geographyTitleHeight;
        const mainColor = channel === 'vn' ? '#f6d96b' : '#6d757a';
        const lightColor = channel === 'vn' ? '#fff6d7' : '#eef0f1';
        const headerText = channel === 'vn' ? '#40370d' : '#ffffff';
        context.fillStyle = '#ffffff';
        context.fillRect(channelX, channelY, channelWidth, channelHeight);
        context.fillStyle = mainColor;
        context.fillRect(channelX, channelY, channelWidth, channelTitleHeight);
        context.fillStyle = headerText;
        context.font = '800 15px Arial, sans-serif';
        context.fillText(channel === 'vn' ? 'Vendas' : 'Pós-Venda', channelX + 11, channelY + 24);

        const headerY = channelY + channelTitleHeight;
        context.fillStyle = lightColor;
        context.fillRect(channelX, headerY, channelWidth, columnHeaderHeight);
        context.fillStyle = '#263238';
        context.font = '800 11px Arial, sans-serif';
        context.fillText('Indicador', channelX + 9, headerY + 20);
        periods.forEach((period, periodIndex) => {
          const periodX = channelX + metricWidth + periodIndex * periodWidth;
          context.fillText(periodNames[period], periodX + 9, headerY + 20);
        });

        const kpis = summaryImageData.kpis?.[channel] || [];
        for (let rowIndex = 0; rowIndex < channelRows; rowIndex += 1) {
          const kpi = kpis[rowIndex];
          const rowY = headerY + columnHeaderHeight + rowIndex * rowHeight;
          context.fillStyle = rowIndex % 2 ? '#f8fafb' : '#ffffff';
          context.fillRect(channelX, rowY, channelWidth, rowHeight);
          if (kpi) {
            context.fillStyle = '#17242b';
            context.font = '700 11px Arial, sans-serif';
            context.fillText(
              fitSummaryCanvasText(context, summaryMetricLabel(channel, kpi), metricWidth - 18),
              channelX + 9,
              rowY + 21,
            );
            periods.forEach((period, periodIndex) => {
              const value = geography.canais?.[channel]?.[period]?.[kpi];
              const status = summaryValueStatus(channel, kpi, value);
              const periodX = channelX + metricWidth + periodIndex * periodWidth;
              context.fillStyle = status === 'good' ? '#138a45' : status === 'bad' ? '#d22929' : '#667780';
              context.font = `${status === 'neutral' ? '700' : '800'} 12px Arial, sans-serif`;
              context.fillText(
                fitSummaryCanvasText(context, summaryValue(value, kpi), periodWidth - 18),
                periodX + 9,
                rowY + 21,
              );
            });
          }
          context.strokeStyle = '#d4dee3';
          context.beginPath();
          context.moveTo(channelX, rowY + rowHeight);
          context.lineTo(channelX + channelWidth, rowY + rowHeight);
          context.stroke();
        }

        context.strokeStyle = '#d4dee3';
        const verticalOffsets = [
          0,
          metricWidth,
          ...periods.map((_, index) => metricWidth + periodWidth * (index + 1)),
        ];
        verticalOffsets.forEach(offset => {
          context.beginPath();
          context.moveTo(channelX + offset, headerY);
          context.lineTo(channelX + offset, channelY + channelHeight);
          context.stroke();
        });
        context.strokeRect(channelX, channelY, channelWidth, channelHeight);
      });
    });

    const legendY = height - legendHeight;
    context.fillStyle = '#ffffff';
    context.fillRect(0, legendY, width, legendHeight);
    context.font = '700 11px Arial, sans-serif';
    context.fillStyle = '#138a45';
    context.fillText('Verde: objetivo atingido', margin, legendY + 25);
    context.fillStyle = '#d22929';
    context.fillText('Vermelho: objetivo não atingido', margin + 180, legendY + 25);
    context.fillStyle = '#667780';
    context.fillText('Valores sem objetivo permanecem neutros', margin + 400, legendY + 25);
    return canvasToBlob(canvas);
  }

  if (summaryImageButton && summaryImageData) {
    summaryImageButton.dataset.summaryGeographies = String(summaryImageData.geografias.length);
    summaryImageButton.addEventListener('click', async () => {
      const originalLabel = summaryImageButton.textContent;
      try {
        summaryImageButton.disabled = true;
        summaryImageButton.textContent = 'Gerando imagem...';
        if (summaryImageStatus) {
          summaryImageStatus.className = 'summary-image-status';
          summaryImageStatus.textContent = 'Compilando Brasil e regionais...';
        }
        const result = await distributeGeneratedImage(
          summaryBrazilRegionsImage,
          'resumo_brasil_regionais_geely.png',
          { clipboardOnly: true },
        );
        if (summaryImageStatus) {
          summaryImageStatus.className = 'summary-image-status success';
          summaryImageStatus.textContent = result === 'copied'
            ? 'Imagem copiada. Use Ctrl+V para colar.'
            : 'A prévia foi aberta para você copiar a imagem.';
        }
        summaryImageButton.textContent = result === 'copied' ? 'Imagem copiada' : 'Prévia aberta';
      } catch (error) {
        if (summaryImageStatus) {
          summaryImageStatus.className = 'summary-image-status error';
          summaryImageStatus.textContent = error.message || 'Não foi possível copiar a imagem Resumo.';
        }
        summaryImageButton.textContent = originalLabel;
      } finally {
        summaryImageButton.disabled = false;
        setTimeout(() => { summaryImageButton.textContent = originalLabel; }, 1800);
      }
    });
  }

  function rankingMtdImage() {
    const panel = document.querySelector('[data-ranking-panel].active');
    if (!panel) throw new Error('Não foi possível localizar o ranking ativo.');
    const channel = panel.dataset.rankingPanel;
    const rows = [...panel.querySelectorAll('tr[data-ranking-dealer]')]
      .filter(row => !row.classList.contains('hidden'))
      .map(row => [
        row.cells[0]?.textContent.trim() || '-',
        row.cells[1]?.querySelector('strong')?.textContent.trim() || '-',
        row.cells[2]?.textContent.trim() || '-',
        row.cells[5]?.textContent.trim() || '-',
        row.cells[6]?.textContent.trim() || '-',
        row.cells[7]?.textContent.trim() || '-',
      ]);
    if (!rows.length) throw new Error('Não há concessionárias visíveis para copiar.');

    const columns = [90, 350, 210, 170, 160, 180];
    const width = columns.reduce((sum, value) => sum + value, 0);
    const titleHeight = 52;
    const headerHeight = 38;
    const rowHeight = 34;
    const canvas = document.createElement('canvas');
    canvas.width = width;
    canvas.height = titleHeight + headerHeight + rows.length * rowHeight;
    const context = canvas.getContext('2d');
    const mainColor = channel === 'vn' ? '#f6d96b' : '#6d757a';
    const lightColor = channel === 'vn' ? '#fff6d7' : '#eef0f1';
    const channelName = channel === 'vn' ? 'Vendas' : 'Pós-Venda';
    context.fillStyle = '#ffffff';
    context.fillRect(0, 0, width, canvas.height);
    context.fillStyle = mainColor;
    context.fillRect(0, 0, width, titleHeight);
    context.fillStyle = '#ffffff';
    context.font = '800 21px Arial, sans-serif';
    context.fillText(`Ranking ${channelName} — Resultados MTD`, 18, 33);

    const headers = ['Posição', 'Concessionária', 'Regional', 'NPS MTD', 'Qtd MTD', 'Dif. D-1'];
    context.fillStyle = lightColor;
    context.fillRect(0, titleHeight, width, headerHeight);
    context.font = '700 14px Arial, sans-serif';
    context.fillStyle = '#263238';
    let x = 0;
    headers.forEach((header, index) => {
      context.fillText(header, x + 10, titleHeight + 25);
      x += columns[index];
    });

    rows.forEach((row, rowIndex) => {
      const y = titleHeight + headerHeight + rowIndex * rowHeight;
      context.fillStyle = rowIndex % 2 ? '#f8fafb' : '#ffffff';
      context.fillRect(0, y, width, rowHeight);
      context.strokeStyle = '#d4dee3';
      context.lineWidth = 1;
      context.beginPath();
      context.moveTo(0, y + rowHeight);
      context.lineTo(width, y + rowHeight);
      context.stroke();
      context.font = '600 13px Arial, sans-serif';
      let cellX = 0;
      row.forEach((value, index) => {
        const text = value.length > 42 && index >= 1 && index <= 2 ? `${value.slice(0, 39)}...` : value;
        const numericValue = Number(value.replace(/\./g, '').replace(',', '.').replace(/[^\d+.-]/g, ''));
        context.fillStyle = index === 3 && Number.isFinite(numericValue)
          ? (numericValue >= 80 ? '#138a45' : '#d22929')
          : index === 5 && /^\+/.test(value) ? '#138a45'
            : index === 5 && /^-\d/.test(value) ? '#d22929'
              : '#17242b';
        context.fillText(text, cellX + 10, y + 22);
        cellX += columns[index];
      });
    });
    return canvasToBlob(canvas);
  }

  rankingSearch?.addEventListener('input', filterRankingOptions);
  rankingChoices.forEach(choice => choice.addEventListener('change', filterRankingRows));
  rankingToggle?.addEventListener('click', () => setRankingMenu(!rankingFilter?.classList.contains('open')));
  rankingClear?.addEventListener('click', () => {
    rankingChoices.forEach(choice => { choice.checked = false; });
    filterRankingRows();
  });

  document.querySelector('[data-summary-excel]')?.addEventListener('click', async event => {
    if (!summaryImageData) return;
    const button = event.currentTarget;
    const original = button.textContent;
    const periods = ['mtd', 'ytd'];
    const periodLabels = { mtd: 'MTD', ytd: 'YTD' };
    const metricKind = kpi => kpi === 'quantidade' ? 'integer'
      : ['estrelas','nota_test_drive'].includes(kpi) ? 'decimal' : 'percent';
    const metricState = (channel,kpi,value) => {
      const objective=summaryImageData.objetivos?.[channel]?.[kpi];
      if(value==null||objective==null)return'neutral';
      return (summaryImageData.menor_melhor||[]).includes(kpi)
        ? (value<=objective?'good':'bad') : (value>=objective?'good':'bad');
    };
    try {
      button.textContent = 'Gerando arquivo...';
      const sheets = ['vn','pv'].map(channel => {
        const rows = [];
        summaryImageData.geografias.forEach(geo => {
        const channelData = geo.canais?.[channel];
        if (!channelData) return;
        (summaryImageData.kpis?.[channel] || []).forEach(kpi => {
            periods.forEach(period => rows.push({
              level: geo.nome === 'Brasil' ? 'brazil' : 'region',
              cells: [
                { v: geo.nome, kind: 'text' },
                { v: channel === 'vn' ? 'Vendas' : 'Pós-Venda', kind: 'text' },
                { v: summaryImageData.rotulos?.[channel]?.[kpi] || kpi, kind: 'text' },
                { v: summaryImageData.objetivos?.[channel]?.[kpi], kind: metricKind(kpi) },
                { v: periodLabels[period], kind: 'text' },
                { v: channelData?.[period]?.[kpi], kind: metricKind(kpi), state: metricState(channel,kpi,channelData?.[period]?.[kpi]) },
              ],
            }));
          });
        });
        return {
          name: channel === 'vn' ? 'Vendas' : 'Pós-Venda', channel,
          title: `Resumo KPIs · ${channel === 'vn' ? 'Vendas' : 'Pós-Venda'}`,
          subtitle: `Data do relatório: ${summaryImageData.data_relatorio} · Arquivo formatado Geely`,
          headers: ['Geografia','Canal','KPI','Objetivo','Período','Resultado'],
          widths: [22,16,44,16,14,18], rows,
        };
      });
      const datePart = String(summaryImageData.data_relatorio || '').replace(/\D+/g, '-').replace(/^-|-$/g, '');
      await window.GeelyExcel.downloadReliable(sheets, `Resumo_KPIs_Geely_${datePart || 'atual'}.xlsx`);
      button.textContent = 'Arquivo gerado';
      if (summaryImageStatus) { summaryImageStatus.className='summary-image-status success'; summaryImageStatus.textContent='Excel formatado baixado.'; }
    } catch (error) {
      button.textContent = 'Não foi possível gerar';
      if (summaryImageStatus) { summaryImageStatus.className='summary-image-status error'; summaryImageStatus.textContent=error.message || 'Falha ao gerar o Excel.'; }
    } finally { setTimeout(() => { button.textContent = original; }, 1800); }
  });

  document.querySelectorAll('[data-model-kpi-target]').forEach(button => button.addEventListener('click', () => {
    const target = button.dataset.modelKpiTarget;
    document.querySelectorAll('[data-model-kpi-target]').forEach(item => item.classList.toggle('active', item === button));
    document.querySelectorAll('[data-model-kpi-pane]').forEach(pane => pane.classList.toggle('active', pane.dataset.modelKpiPane === target));
  }));

  document.querySelector('[data-ranking-copy-mtd]')?.addEventListener('click', async event => {
    const button = event.currentTarget;
    const originalLabel = button.textContent;
    try {
      button.textContent = 'Gerando imagem...';
      const result = await distributeGeneratedImage(
        rankingMtdImage,
        'ranking_mtd_geely.png',
        { clipboardOnly: true },
      );
      button.textContent = result === 'copied' ? 'Imagem copiada' : 'Prévia aberta';
    } catch (error) {
      setMessage(error.message || 'Não foi possível copiar o ranking.', 'error');
      button.textContent = originalLabel;
      return;
    }
    setTimeout(() => { button.textContent = originalLabel; }, 1800);
  });
  document.addEventListener('click', event => {
    if (rankingFilter && !rankingFilter.contains(event.target)) setRankingMenu(false);
  });
  document.addEventListener('keydown', event => {
    if (event.key === 'Escape') setRankingMenu(false);
  });
  filterRankingOptions();
  filterRankingRows();

  document.querySelectorAll('[data-mots-target]').forEach(button => {
    button.addEventListener('click', event => {
      event.preventDefault();
      activatePanel('mots', button.dataset.motsTarget);
    });
  });
  activatePanel('mots', 'vn');

  const motsSearch = $('motsDealerSearch');
  const motsChoices = [...document.querySelectorAll('[data-mots-dealer-choice]')];
  const motsClear = document.querySelector('[data-mots-filter-clear]');
  const motsSelection = $('motsDealerSelection');
  const motsFilter = document.querySelector('[data-mots-filter]');
  const motsToggle = document.querySelector('[data-mots-filter-toggle]');
  const motsGroupSearch = $('motsGroupSearch');
  const motsGroupChoices = [...document.querySelectorAll('[data-mots-group-choice]')];
  const motsGroupClear = document.querySelector('[data-mots-group-filter-clear]');
  const motsGroupSelection = $('motsGroupSelection');
  const motsGroupFilter = document.querySelector('[data-mots-group-filter]');
  const motsGroupToggle = document.querySelector('[data-mots-group-filter-toggle]');

  function setMotsMenu(open) {
    if (!motsFilter || !motsToggle) return;
    motsFilter.classList.toggle('open', open);
    motsToggle.setAttribute('aria-expanded', String(open));
    if (open) {
      setMotsGroupMenu(false);
      motsSearch?.focus();
    }
  }

  function setMotsGroupMenu(open) {
    if (!motsGroupFilter || !motsGroupToggle) return;
    motsGroupFilter.classList.toggle('open', open);
    motsGroupToggle.setAttribute('aria-expanded', String(open));
    if (open) {
      if (motsFilter) motsFilter.classList.remove('open');
      motsToggle?.setAttribute('aria-expanded', 'false');
      motsGroupSearch?.focus();
    }
  }

  function filterMotsOptions() {
    const search = normalizeSearch(motsSearch?.value);
    let visible = 0;
    document.querySelectorAll('[data-mots-dealer-option]').forEach(option => {
      const show = !search || (option.dataset.search || '').includes(search);
      option.classList.toggle('hidden', !show);
      if (show) visible += 1;
    });
    document.querySelector('[data-mots-dealer-no-results]')?.classList.toggle('hidden', visible > 0);
  }

  function filterMotsGroupOptions() {
    const search = normalizeSearch(motsGroupSearch?.value);
    let visible = 0;
    document.querySelectorAll('[data-mots-group-option]').forEach(option => {
      const show = !search || (option.dataset.search || '').includes(search);
      option.classList.toggle('hidden', !show);
      if (show) visible += 1;
    });
    document.querySelector('[data-mots-group-no-results]')?.classList.toggle('hidden', visible > 0);
  }

  function filterMotsRows() {
    const selected = new Set(motsChoices.filter(choice => choice.checked).map(choice => choice.value));
    const selectedGroups = new Set(
      motsGroupChoices.filter(choice => choice.checked).map(choice => choice.value),
    );
    const hasSelection = selected.size > 0;
    const hasGroupSelection = selectedGroups.size > 0;
    document.querySelectorAll('[data-mots-panel]').forEach(panel => {
      let visible = 0;
      const rows = panel.querySelectorAll('tr[data-mots-dealer]');
      rows.forEach(row => {
        const show = (!hasSelection || selected.has(row.dataset.motsDealer))
          && (!hasGroupSelection || selectedGroups.has(row.dataset.motsGroup));
        row.classList.toggle('hidden', !show);
        if (show) visible += 1;
      });
      panel.querySelector('[data-mots-filter-empty]')?.classList.toggle('hidden', rows.length === 0 || visible > 0);
    });
    if (motsSelection) {
      motsSelection.textContent = hasSelection
        ? `${selected.size} concessionária${selected.size === 1 ? '' : 's'} selecionada${selected.size === 1 ? '' : 's'}`
        : 'Todas as concessionárias';
    }
    motsClear?.classList.toggle('hidden', !hasSelection);
    if (motsGroupSelection) {
      motsGroupSelection.textContent = hasGroupSelection
        ? `${selectedGroups.size} grupo${selectedGroups.size === 1 ? '' : 's'} selecionado${selectedGroups.size === 1 ? '' : 's'}`
        : 'Todos os grupos';
    }
    motsGroupClear?.classList.toggle('hidden', !hasGroupSelection);
  }

  motsSearch?.addEventListener('input', filterMotsOptions);
  motsChoices.forEach(choice => choice.addEventListener('change', filterMotsRows));
  motsToggle?.addEventListener('click', () => setMotsMenu(!motsFilter?.classList.contains('open')));
  motsGroupSearch?.addEventListener('input', filterMotsGroupOptions);
  motsGroupChoices.forEach(choice => choice.addEventListener('change', filterMotsRows));
  motsGroupToggle?.addEventListener('click', () => setMotsGroupMenu(!motsGroupFilter?.classList.contains('open')));
  motsClear?.addEventListener('click', () => {
    motsChoices.forEach(choice => { choice.checked = false; });
    filterMotsRows();
  });
  motsGroupClear?.addEventListener('click', () => {
    motsGroupChoices.forEach(choice => { choice.checked = false; });
    filterMotsRows();
  });
  document.addEventListener('click', event => {
    if (motsFilter && !motsFilter.contains(event.target)) setMotsMenu(false);
    if (motsGroupFilter && !motsGroupFilter.contains(event.target)) setMotsGroupMenu(false);
  });
  document.addEventListener('keydown', event => {
    if (event.key === 'Escape') {
      setMotsMenu(false);
      setMotsGroupMenu(false);
    }
  });
  document.querySelectorAll('[data-mots-period]').forEach(button => {
    button.addEventListener('click', () => {
      const period = button.dataset.motsPeriod;
      document.querySelectorAll('[data-mots-period]').forEach(item => {
        item.classList.toggle('active', item === button);
      });
      document.querySelectorAll('[data-mots-table-period]').forEach(table => {
        table.classList.toggle('hidden', table.dataset.motsTablePeriod !== period);
      });
    });
  });
  filterMotsOptions();
  filterMotsGroupOptions();
  filterMotsRows();

  document.querySelectorAll('[data-verb-target]').forEach(button => {
    button.addEventListener('click', event => {
      event.preventDefault();
      activatePanel('verb', button.dataset.verbTarget);
      filterReviews();
    });
  });
  activatePanel('verb', 'vn');

  const controls = document.querySelector('.server-controls');
  const toggleControls = $('btnToggleControls');
  if (controls && toggleControls) {
    const collapsed = storageGet('geely.controlsCollapsed') === '1';
    controls.classList.toggle('collapsed', collapsed);
    toggleControls.textContent = collapsed ? 'Mostrar opções' : 'Recolher';
    toggleControls.addEventListener('click', () => {
      const next = !controls.classList.contains('collapsed');
      controls.classList.toggle('collapsed', next);
      toggleControls.textContent = next ? 'Mostrar opções' : 'Recolher';
      storageSet('geely.controlsCollapsed', next ? '1' : '0');
    });
  }

  async function fillD1(dateId, startId, endId) {
    const date = $(dateId)?.value;
    if (!date) return;
    const auto = $('autoFimSemana')?.checked ? '1' : '0';
    setMessage('Calculando o D-1 padrão...');
    try {
      const response = await fetch(`/api/d1-padrao?data=${encodeURIComponent(date)}&auto_fds=${auto}`);
      const payload = await response.json();
      if (!response.ok || !payload.ok) throw new Error(payload.erro || 'Falha ao calcular o D-1.');
      $(startId).value = payload.inicio;
      $(endId).value = payload.fim;
      setMessage('D-1 preenchido.', 'success');
    } catch (error) {
      setMessage(error.message, 'error');
    }
  }

  $('dataAtual')?.addEventListener('change', () => fillD1('dataAtual', 'd1AtualInicio', 'd1AtualFim'));
  $('dataAnterior')?.addEventListener('change', () => fillD1('dataAnterior', 'd1AnteriorInicio', 'd1AnteriorFim'));
  $('autoFimSemana')?.addEventListener('change', () => {
    fillD1('dataAtual', 'd1AtualInicio', 'd1AtualFim');
    fillD1('dataAnterior', 'd1AnteriorInicio', 'd1AnteriorFim');
  });

  function buildQuery() {
    const fields = {
      data_anterior: $('dataAnterior')?.value,
      data_atual: $('dataAtual')?.value,
      d1_anterior_inicio: $('d1AnteriorInicio')?.value,
      d1_anterior_fim: $('d1AnteriorFim')?.value,
      d1_atual_inicio: $('d1AtualInicio')?.value,
      d1_atual_fim: $('d1AtualFim')?.value,
      auto_fds: $('autoFimSemana')?.checked ? '1' : '0',
    };
    for (const [key, value] of Object.entries(fields)) {
      if (key !== 'auto_fds' && !value) throw new Error('Preencha todas as datas.');
    }
    return new URLSearchParams(fields);
  }

  $('dashboardForm')?.addEventListener('submit', () => {
    showLoading(true);
    setMessage('Recalculando todas as abas...');
  });

  $('btnReload')?.addEventListener('click', async () => {
    try {
      showLoading(true);
      setMessage('Relendo as cinco bases...');
      const response = await fetch('/api/recarregar', { method: 'POST' });
      const payload = await response.json();
      if (!response.ok || !payload.ok) throw new Error(payload.erro || 'Falha ao recarregar as bases.');
      setMessage('Bases recarregadas. Atualizando o relatório...', 'success');
      window.location.reload();
    } catch (error) {
      setMessage(error.message, 'error');
    } finally {
      showLoading(false);
    }
  });

  function fileNameFromResponse(response, fallback) {
    const disposition = response.headers.get('Content-Disposition') || '';
    const utf8 = disposition.match(/filename\*=UTF-8''([^;]+)/i);
    if (utf8) {
      try { return decodeURIComponent(utf8[1]); } catch (_) {}
    }
    const normal = disposition.match(/filename="?([^";]+)"?/i);
    return normal ? normal[1] : fallback;
  }

  document.querySelectorAll('[data-export]').forEach(button => {
    button.addEventListener('click', async () => {
      const type = button.dataset.export;
      const label = type === 'pdf' ? 'PDF' : 'HTML';
      try {
        const query = buildQuery();
        showLoading(true);
        setMessage(`Gerando ${label}...`);
        const response = await fetch(`/exportar/${type}?${query.toString()}`);
        if (!response.ok) {
          let detail = '';
          try { detail = (await response.json()).erro || ''; } catch (_) { detail = await response.text(); }
          throw new Error(detail || `Não foi possível gerar ${label}.`);
        }
        const blob = await response.blob();
        if (!blob.size) throw new Error(`${label} foi gerado sem conteúdo.`);
        const fallback = type === 'pdf' ? 'Relatorio_Qualidade_Geely.pdf' : 'Relatorio_Qualidade_Geely.html';
        const url = URL.createObjectURL(blob);
        const link = document.createElement('a');
        link.href = url;
        link.download = fileNameFromResponse(response, fallback);
        document.body.appendChild(link);
        link.click();
        link.remove();
        setTimeout(() => URL.revokeObjectURL(url), 1800);
        setMessage(`${label} gerado com sucesso.`, 'success');
      } catch (error) {
        setMessage(error.message, 'error');
      } finally {
        showLoading(false);
      }
    });
  });

  const portableSave = $('portableSave');
  const portablePrint = $('portablePrint');
  const portableStatus = $('portableStatus');

  function setPortableStatus(text, type = '') {
    if (!portableStatus) return;
    portableStatus.textContent = text || '';
    portableStatus.className = `portable-status${type ? ` ${type}` : ''}`;
  }

  function portableReportBlob() {
    const root = document.documentElement.cloneNode(true);
    root.classList.remove('js-ready');
    root.classList.add('no-js');
    const clonedBody = root.querySelector('body');
    clonedBody?.removeAttribute('style');
    root.querySelector('.review-modal')?.classList.remove('open');
    root.querySelectorAll('.ranking-filter').forEach(filter => filter.classList.remove('open'));
    const clonedModal = root.querySelector('#modalContent');
    if (clonedModal) clonedModal.textContent = '';
    root.querySelectorAll('[data-review-card].hidden, tr[data-ranking-dealer].hidden, [data-ranking-dealer-option].hidden, tr[data-mots-dealer].hidden, [data-mots-dealer-option].hidden')
      .forEach(element => element.classList.remove('hidden'));
    return new Blob([`<!DOCTYPE html>\n${root.outerHTML}`], { type: 'text/html;charset=utf-8' });
  }

  function portableFileName() {
    return document.body.dataset.reportFilename || 'Relatorio_Qualidade_Geely.html';
  }

  portableSave?.addEventListener('click', () => {
    try {
      downloadBlob(portableReportBlob(), portableFileName());
      setPortableStatus('Uma cópia completa do relatório foi salva.', 'success');
    } catch (error) {
      setPortableStatus(error.message || 'Não foi possível salvar o relatório.', 'error');
    }
  });

  portablePrint?.addEventListener('click', () => {
    setPortableStatus('Abrindo as opções de impressão. No celular, escolha salvar como PDF.');
    window.print();
  });

  const modelSelect = $('verbModelo');
  const regionSelect = $('verbRegiao');
  const noteChoices = [...document.querySelectorAll('[data-verb-note]')];
  const noteSummary = $('verbNotasResumo');
  const noteClear = $('verbNotasLimpar');
  const searchInput = $('verbBusca');
  const keywordInput = $('verbPalavra');
  [modelSelect, regionSelect].forEach(el => el?.addEventListener('change', filterReviews));
  noteChoices.forEach(choice => choice.addEventListener('change', filterReviews));
  searchInput?.addEventListener('input', filterReviews);
  keywordInput?.addEventListener('input', filterReviews);
  noteClear?.addEventListener('click', () => {
    noteChoices.forEach(choice => { choice.checked = false; });
    filterReviews();
  });

  function activeVerbChannel() {
    return document.querySelector('[data-verb-target].active')?.dataset.verbTarget || 'vn';
  }

  function filterReviews() {
    const channel = activeVerbChannel();
    const model = modelSelect?.value || '';
    const region = regionSelect?.value || '';
    const notes = new Set(noteChoices.filter(choice => choice.checked).map(choice => choice.value));
    const search = normalizeSearch(searchInput?.value);
    const keyword = normalizeSearch(keywordInput?.value);
    if (noteSummary) noteSummary.textContent = notes.size ? [...notes].sort().join(', ') : 'Todas';
    let visible = 0;
    document.querySelectorAll('[data-review-card]').forEach(card => {
      const show = card.dataset.canal === channel
        && (!model || card.dataset.modelo === model)
        && (!region || card.dataset.regional === region)
        && (!notes.size || notes.has(card.dataset.nota))
        && (!search || (card.dataset.search || '').includes(search))
        && (!keyword || (card.dataset.keywords || '').includes(keyword));
      card.classList.toggle('hidden', !show);
      if (show) visible += 1;
    });
    $('verbNoResults')?.classList.toggle('hidden', visible > 0);
  }
  filterReviews();

  const modal = $('reviewModal');
  const modalContent = $('modalContent');
  let modalReturnFocus = null;
  function openReview(card) {
    if (!modal || !modalContent) return;
    modalReturnFocus = document.activeElement;
    const clone = card.cloneNode(true);
    clone.querySelector('.review-open')?.remove();
    if (typeof modalContent.replaceChildren === 'function') modalContent.replaceChildren(clone);
    else {
      modalContent.textContent = '';
      modalContent.appendChild(clone);
    }
    modal.classList.add('open');
    modal.setAttribute('aria-hidden', 'false');
    document.body.classList.add('modal-open');
    try { $('modalClose')?.focus({ preventScroll: true }); }
    catch (_) { $('modalClose')?.focus(); }
  }
  function closeReview() {
    modal?.classList.remove('open');
    modal?.setAttribute('aria-hidden', 'true');
    document.body.classList.remove('modal-open');
    try { modalReturnFocus?.focus({ preventScroll: true }); }
    catch (_) { modalReturnFocus?.focus(); }
  }
  document.querySelectorAll('[data-review-card]').forEach(card => {
    card.addEventListener('click', event => {
      if (event.target.closest('button, summary, details')) return;
      openReview(card);
    });
    card.querySelector('.review-open')?.addEventListener('click', event => {
      event.stopPropagation();
      openReview(card);
    });
    card.addEventListener('keydown', event => {
      if (event.target.closest('summary, details')) return;
      if (event.key === 'Enter' || event.key === ' ') {
        event.preventDefault();
        openReview(card);
      }
    });
  });
  $('modalClose')?.addEventListener('click', closeReview);
  modal?.addEventListener('click', event => { if (event.target === modal) closeReview(); });
  document.addEventListener('keydown', event => { if (event.key === 'Escape') closeReview(); });

  document.addEventListener('click', event => {
    const toggle = event.target.closest('[data-vin-toggle]');
    if (!toggle) return;
    event.preventDefault();
    event.stopPropagation();
    const fact = toggle.closest('.review-vin-fact');
    const visible = toggle.getAttribute('aria-pressed') !== 'true';
    toggle.setAttribute('aria-pressed', String(visible));
    toggle.setAttribute('aria-label', visible ? 'Ocultar chassi' : 'Mostrar chassi');
    toggle.setAttribute('title', visible ? 'Ocultar chassi' : 'Mostrar chassi');
    fact?.classList.toggle('vin-visible', visible);
    const masked = fact?.querySelector('.vin-masked');
    const revealed = fact?.querySelector('.vin-revealed');
    if (masked) masked.hidden = visible;
    if (revealed) revealed.hidden = !visible;
  });

  function copyComputedStyles(source, target) {
    const sourceNodes = [source, ...source.querySelectorAll('*')];
    const targetNodes = [target, ...target.querySelectorAll('*')];
    sourceNodes.forEach((sourceNode, index) => {
      const targetNode = targetNodes[index];
      if (!targetNode?.style) return;
      const computed = window.getComputedStyle(sourceNode);
      for (let propertyIndex = 0; propertyIndex < computed.length; propertyIndex += 1) {
        const property = computed[propertyIndex];
        targetNode.style.setProperty(
          property,
          computed.getPropertyValue(property),
          computed.getPropertyPriority(property),
        );
      }
    });
  }

  async function cardToPng(card) {
    if (document.fonts?.ready) await document.fonts.ready;
    const rect = card.getBoundingClientRect();
    const width = Math.ceil(rect.width);
    const height = Math.ceil(Math.max(rect.height, card.scrollHeight));
    const clone = card.cloneNode(true);
    copyComputedStyles(card, clone);
    clone.style.width = `${width}px`;
    clone.style.height = `${height}px`;
    clone.style.maxHeight = 'none';
    clone.style.margin = '0';
    clone.style.transform = 'none';
    if (clone.classList.contains('channel-pv')) {
      clone.style.background = '#eef0f1';
      clone.style.borderLeftColor = '#6d757a';
    } else if (!clone.classList.contains('hot-alert')) {
      clone.style.background = '#fff6d7';
      clone.style.borderLeftColor = '#f6d96b';
    }
    const style = `
      <style>*{box-sizing:border-box}body{margin:0;font-family:Arial,sans-serif;color:#17242b}.review-card{width:${width}px;border:1px solid #d4dee3;border-left:6px solid #0067a0;border-radius:16px;background:#eaf6fb;overflow:hidden}.review-card.channel-pv{background:#f2f3f5;border-left-color:#71808a}.review-card.hot-alert{background:#fff1e6;border-left-color:#e67722}.review-hero{display:flex;justify-content:space-between;gap:18px;padding:16px;border-bottom:1px solid #d4dee3}.review-model-line{display:flex;align-items:center;gap:8px;margin-bottom:8px}.review-model{font-weight:800;font-size:24px}.professional-driver-badge{display:inline-flex;align-items:center;justify-content:center;width:27px;height:27px;border:1px solid #9bc8dd;border-radius:999px;background:rgba(255,255,255,.75);color:#004a73}.professional-driver-badge svg{width:18px;height:18px;fill:none;stroke:currentColor;stroke-width:1.7;stroke-linecap:round;stroke-linejoin:round}.review-client{font-weight:800;font-size:20px;margin-bottom:10px}.move-brasil-label{display:inline-flex;margin:-3px 0 9px;padding:4px 7px;border:1px solid #9ed5b5;border-radius:6px;background:#e4f5ea;color:#0f6e38;font-size:10px;font-weight:900;letter-spacing:.05em;text-transform:uppercase}.review-facts{display:grid;gap:6px}.review-fact{display:flex;gap:8px;color:#667780;font-size:14px}.review-fact strong{color:#17242b}.review-meta{display:flex;flex-wrap:wrap;gap:8px;margin-top:10px;color:#667780;font-size:11px;font-weight:700}.review-scorebox{display:grid;gap:8px;min-width:260px}.score-row{display:flex;justify-content:space-between;gap:10px;color:#667780;font-size:14px}.score-pill{display:inline-flex;align-items:center;gap:8px;padding:8px 11px;border-radius:12px;background:#fff;border:1px solid #d4dee3;font-weight:700}.score-pill.note-1{background:#fff0f0;border-color:rgba(229,57,53,.26);color:#e53935}.score-pill.note-2{background:#fff0e8;border-color:rgba(200,77,14,.28);color:#c84d0e}.score-pill.note-3{background:#fff4e5;border-color:rgba(242,140,40,.36);color:#f28c28}.score-pill.note-4{background:#fff9d9;border-color:rgba(213,168,0,.38);color:#d5a800}.score-pill.note-5{background:#edf7ef;border-color:rgba(46,125,50,.28);color:#2e7d32}.ha-badge{padding:4px 6px;background:#e67722;color:#fff;border-radius:5px;font-size:10px;font-weight:800}.review-questions{display:flex;flex-wrap:wrap;gap:8px;padding:12px 16px 0}.question-chip{padding:8px 11px;border-radius:999px;background:#fff;border:1px solid #d4dee3;font-size:12px}.review-sections{padding:10px 16px 16px;display:grid;gap:10px}.review-section{padding-top:10px;border-top:1px solid #d4dee3}.review-section h4{margin:0 0 8px;color:#9b9500;font-size:10px;letter-spacing:.15em;text-transform:uppercase}.review-section p{margin:0;font-size:16px;line-height:1.5;color:#515151}.review-open{display:none}</style>`;
    const svg = `<svg xmlns="http://www.w3.org/2000/svg" width="${width}" height="${height}"><foreignObject width="100%" height="100%"><div xmlns="http://www.w3.org/1999/xhtml">${style}${clone.outerHTML}</div></foreignObject></svg>`;
    const url = `data:image/svg+xml;charset=utf-8,${encodeURIComponent(svg)}`;
    const image = new Image();
    await new Promise((resolve, reject) => { image.onload = resolve; image.onerror = reject; image.src = url; });
    const canvas = document.createElement('canvas');
    canvas.width = width * 2;
    canvas.height = height * 2;
    const ctx = canvas.getContext('2d');
    ctx.scale(2, 2);
    ctx.fillStyle = '#ffffff';
    ctx.fillRect(0, 0, width, height);
    ctx.drawImage(image, 0, 0);
    return canvasToBlob(canvas);
  }

  async function cardTextToPng(card) {
    const canvas = document.createElement('canvas');
    const context = canvas.getContext('2d');
    const width = 1000;
    const padding = 36;
    const maxTextWidth = width - padding * 2;
    context.font = '16px Arial, sans-serif';
    const lines = [];
    card.innerText.split('\n').map(text => text.trim()).filter(Boolean).forEach(text => {
      let current = '';
      text.split(/\s+/).forEach(word => {
        const candidate = current ? `${current} ${word}` : word;
        if (context.measureText(candidate).width > maxTextWidth && current) {
          lines.push(current);
          current = word;
        } else current = candidate;
      });
      if (current) lines.push(current);
      lines.push('');
    });
    const height = Math.max(180, padding * 2 + 48 + lines.length * 25);
    canvas.width = width;
    canvas.height = height;
    context.fillStyle = '#ffffff';
    context.fillRect(0, 0, width, height);
    context.fillStyle = '#ed7d31';
    context.fillRect(0, 0, width, 58);
    context.fillStyle = '#ffffff';
    context.font = '800 22px Arial, sans-serif';
    context.fillText('Verbalização Geely', padding, 37);
    context.fillStyle = '#17242b';
    context.font = '16px Arial, sans-serif';
    let y = 88;
    lines.forEach(line => {
      context.fillText(line, padding, y);
      y += 25;
    });
    return canvasToBlob(canvas);
  }

  async function cardCanvasToPng(card) {
    const canvas = document.createElement('canvas');
    const context = canvas.getContext('2d');
    const width = 1200;
    const padding = 34;
    const channelPv = card.classList.contains('channel-pv');
    const background = channelPv ? '#eef0f1' : '#fff6d7';
    const accent = channelPv ? '#6d757a' : '#f6d96b';
    const model = card.querySelector('.review-model')?.textContent.trim() || '';
    const client = card.querySelector('.review-client')?.textContent.trim() || '';
    const professionalDriver = Boolean(card.querySelector('.professional-driver-badge'));
    const moveBrasil = card.querySelector('.move-brasil-label')?.textContent.trim() || '';
    const facts = [...card.querySelectorAll('.review-fact')].map(item => item.innerText.replace(/\s+/g, ' ').trim());
    const meta = card.querySelector('.review-meta')?.innerText.replace(/\s+/g, ' · ').trim() || '';
    const scores = [...card.querySelectorAll('.score-row')].map(item => {
      const pill = item.querySelector('.score-pill');
      const noteClass = [...(pill?.classList || [])].find(name => /^note-\d$/.test(name));
      return {
        label: item.firstElementChild?.textContent.trim() || '',
        value: pill?.querySelector('strong')?.textContent.trim() || '-',
        note: Number(noteClass?.replace('note-', '')) || 0,
      };
    });
    const questions = [...card.querySelectorAll('.question-chip')].map(item => ({
      label: item.querySelector('strong')?.textContent.replace(/:\s*$/, '').trim() || '',
      value: item.querySelector('span')?.textContent.trim() || '-',
    }));
    const sections = [...card.querySelectorAll('.review-section')].map(item => ({
      title: item.querySelector('h4')?.textContent.trim() || '',
      text: item.querySelector('p')?.textContent.trim() || '',
    }));
    const wrap = (text, maxWidth, font) => {
      context.font = font;
      const lines = [];
      let current = '';
      text.split(/\s+/).filter(Boolean).forEach(word => {
        const candidate = current ? `${current} ${word}` : word;
        if (context.measureText(candidate).width > maxWidth && current) {
          lines.push(current);
          current = word;
        } else current = candidate;
      });
      if (current) lines.push(current);
      return lines;
    };
    const preparedQuestions = questions.map(question => ({
      ...question,
      lines: wrap(question.label, width - padding * 2 - 190, '600 16px Arial'),
    }));
    const questionsHeight = preparedQuestions.reduce(
      (sum, question) => sum + Math.max(42, question.lines.length * 20 + 16) + 8,
      0,
    );
    const preparedSections = sections.map(section => ({ ...section, lines: wrap(section.text, width - padding * 2, '19px Arial') }));
    const sectionsHeight = preparedSections.reduce((sum, section) => sum + 68 + section.lines.length * 28, 0);
    const heroHeight = Math.max(230, 50 + scores.length * 42, 165 + facts.length * 25 + (moveBrasil ? 32 : 0));
    const height = Math.max(420, heroHeight + questionsHeight + sectionsHeight + 36);
    canvas.width = width;
    canvas.height = height;

    const roundedRect = (x, y, w, h, radius) => {
      context.beginPath();
      if (typeof context.roundRect === 'function') {
        context.roundRect(x, y, w, h, radius);
        return;
      }
      const r = Math.min(radius, w / 2, h / 2);
      context.moveTo(x + r, y);
      context.lineTo(x + w - r, y);
      context.quadraticCurveTo(x + w, y, x + w, y + r);
      context.lineTo(x + w, y + h - r);
      context.quadraticCurveTo(x + w, y + h, x + w - r, y + h);
      context.lineTo(x + r, y + h);
      context.quadraticCurveTo(x, y + h, x, y + h - r);
      context.lineTo(x, y + r);
      context.quadraticCurveTo(x, y, x + r, y);
      context.closePath();
    };

    context.fillStyle = background;
    context.fillRect(0, 0, width, height);
    context.fillStyle = accent;
    context.fillRect(0, 0, 10, height);
    context.strokeStyle = '#d4dee3';
    context.strokeRect(.5, .5, width - 1, height - 1);
    context.fillStyle = '#17242b';
    context.font = '800 30px Arial';
    context.fillText(model, padding, 52);
    if (professionalDriver) {
      const badgeX = Math.min(744, padding + context.measureText(model).width + 22);
      const badgeY = 42;
      context.beginPath();
      context.arc(badgeX, badgeY, 15, 0, Math.PI * 2);
      context.fillStyle = 'rgba(255,255,255,.78)';
      context.fill();
      context.strokeStyle = '#77aec9';
      context.lineWidth = 1.5;
      context.stroke();
      context.strokeStyle = '#004a73';
      context.lineWidth = 1.7;
      context.beginPath();
      context.moveTo(badgeX - 8, badgeY + 1);
      context.lineTo(badgeX - 5, badgeY - 5);
      context.lineTo(badgeX + 5, badgeY - 5);
      context.lineTo(badgeX + 8, badgeY + 1);
      context.lineTo(badgeX + 8, badgeY + 6);
      context.lineTo(badgeX - 8, badgeY + 6);
      context.closePath();
      context.stroke();
      context.beginPath();
      context.arc(badgeX - 5, badgeY + 3, 1.2, 0, Math.PI * 2);
      context.arc(badgeX + 5, badgeY + 3, 1.2, 0, Math.PI * 2);
      context.fillStyle = '#004a73';
      context.fill();
    }
    context.fillStyle = '#17242b';
    context.font = '700 22px Arial';
    context.fillText(client, padding, 88);
    context.font = '16px Arial';
    let y = 118;
    if (moveBrasil) {
      context.font = '800 13px Arial';
      const labelWidth = context.measureText(moveBrasil).width + 22;
      roundedRect(padding, y - 18, labelWidth, 25, 7);
      context.fillStyle = '#e4f5ea';
      context.fill();
      context.strokeStyle = '#9ed5b5';
      context.stroke();
      context.fillStyle = '#0f6e38';
      context.fillText(moveBrasil, padding + 11, y);
      y += 34;
    }
    context.fillStyle = '#17242b';
    context.font = '16px Arial';
    facts.forEach(fact => { context.fillText(fact, padding, y); y += 25; });
    context.fillStyle = '#667780';
    context.font = '700 14px Arial';
    context.fillText(meta, padding, y + 4);

    let scoreY = 38;
    const noteColors = { 1: ['#fff0f0', '#e53935'], 2: ['#fff0e8', '#c84d0e'], 3: ['#fff4e5', '#f28c28'], 4: ['#fff9d9', '#d5a800'], 5: ['#edf7ef', '#2e7d32'] };
    scores.forEach(score => {
      roundedRect(780, scoreY, 384, 34, 9);
      context.fillStyle = '#ffffff';
      context.fill();
      context.strokeStyle = '#d4dee3';
      context.stroke();
      context.fillStyle = '#17242b';
      context.font = '700 15px Arial';
      context.fillText(score.label, 792, scoreY + 22);
      const [pillBackground, pillColor] = noteColors[score.note] || ['#ffffff', '#667780'];
      context.font = '17px Arial';
      for (let star = 1; star <= 5; star += 1) {
        context.fillStyle = star <= score.note ? pillColor : '#cbd4d9';
        context.fillText('★', 932 + (star - 1) * 21, scoreY + 23);
      }
      context.font = '800 14px Arial';
      const pillWidth = Math.max(54, context.measureText(score.value).width + 20);
      roundedRect(1154 - pillWidth, scoreY + 4, pillWidth, 26, 8);
      context.fillStyle = pillBackground;
      context.fill();
      context.strokeStyle = pillColor;
      context.stroke();
      context.fillStyle = pillColor;
      context.font = '800 14px Arial';
      context.fillText(score.value, 1164 - pillWidth, scoreY + 22);
      scoreY += 42;
    });
    y = Math.max(y + 34, scoreY + 12);
    context.strokeStyle = '#d4dee3';
    context.beginPath(); context.moveTo(padding, y); context.lineTo(width - padding, y); context.stroke();
    y += 28;
    preparedQuestions.forEach(question => {
      const chipHeight = Math.max(42, question.lines.length * 20 + 16);
      roundedRect(padding, y - 21, width - padding * 2, chipHeight, 12);
      context.fillStyle = '#ffffff';
      context.fill();
      context.strokeStyle = '#d4dee3';
      context.stroke();
      context.fillStyle = '#17242b';
      context.font = '600 16px Arial';
      question.lines.forEach((line, index) => context.fillText(line, padding + 14, y + index * 20 + 3));

      const normalizedAnswer = normalizeSearch(question.value);
      const answerGood = normalizedAnswer === 'sim';
      const answerBad = normalizedAnswer === 'nao';
      const answerText = answerGood ? '✓ Sim' : answerBad ? '✕ Não' : '—';
      const answerBackground = answerGood ? '#e4f5ea' : answerBad ? '#fde8e8' : '#eef2f4';
      const answerColor = answerGood ? '#138a45' : answerBad ? '#d22929' : '#667780';
      context.font = '800 15px Arial';
      const answerWidth = Math.max(76, context.measureText(answerText).width + 24);
      const answerX = width - padding - answerWidth - 10;
      const answerY = y - 14 + (chipHeight - 30) / 2;
      roundedRect(answerX, answerY, answerWidth, 30, 15);
      context.fillStyle = answerBackground;
      context.fill();
      context.strokeStyle = answerColor;
      context.stroke();
      context.fillStyle = answerColor;
      context.fillText(answerText, answerX + 12, answerY + 20);
      y += chipHeight + 8;
    });
    preparedSections.forEach(section => {
      y += 14;
      context.strokeStyle = '#d4dee3';
      context.beginPath(); context.moveTo(padding, y); context.lineTo(width - padding, y); context.stroke();
      y += 27;
      context.fillStyle = '#756013';
      context.font = '800 13px Arial';
      context.fillText(section.title.toUpperCase(), padding, y);
      y += 27;
      context.fillStyle = '#515151';
      context.font = '19px Arial';
      section.lines.forEach(line => { context.fillText(line, padding, y); y += 28; });
    });
    return canvasToBlob(canvas);
  }

  $('modalCopy')?.addEventListener('click', async () => {
    const card = modalContent?.querySelector('.review-card');
    if (!card) return;
    const button = $('modalCopy');
    const status = $('modalCopyStatus');
    const originalLabel = button?.textContent || 'Copiar imagem';
    if (status) status.textContent = 'Gerando imagem...';
    try {
      const result = await distributeGeneratedImage(() => cardToPng(card), 'verbalizacao_geely.png');
      if (button) button.textContent = result === 'shared' ? 'Imagem compartilhada'
        : result === 'copied' ? 'Imagem copiada'
          : result === 'cancelled' ? originalLabel : 'Imagem baixada';
      if (status) status.textContent = result === 'shared'
        ? 'Escolha o WhatsApp ou outro aplicativo no menu de compartilhamento.'
        : result === 'copied' ? 'A imagem está na área de transferência.'
          : result === 'cancelled' ? 'Compartilhamento cancelado.'
            : 'A imagem foi baixada para o dispositivo.';
      setTimeout(() => { if (button) button.textContent = originalLabel; }, 1800);
    } catch (error) {
      setMessage(error.message || 'Não foi possível copiar a imagem.', 'error');
      if (status) status.textContent = `Não foi possível gerar a imagem: ${error.message || 'erro desconhecido.'}`;
      if (button) button.textContent = originalLabel;
    }
  });
})();

(() => {
  const dataEl = document.getElementById('dealerExplorerData');
  if (!dataEl) return;
  let D = {};
  try { D = JSON.parse(dataEl.textContent || '{}'); } catch (_) { return; }
  const dealers = Object.values(D.dealers || {});
  const months = D.meses || [];
  const current = D.mes_atual;
  const ytdKeys = months.map(m => m.key);
  const esc = value => String(value ?? '').replace(/[&<>"']/g, c => ({'&':'&amp;','<':'&lt;','>':'&gt;','"':'&quot;',"'":'&#39;'}[c]));
  const norm = value => String(value || '').normalize('NFD').replace(/[\u0300-\u036f]/g,'').toLowerCase().trim();
  const fmt = (value,kpi='') => value == null || Number.isNaN(value) ? '-' : ['quantidade','emails_enviados','emails_entregues','quantidade_retorno'].includes(kpi) ? Math.round(value).toLocaleString('pt-BR') : ['estrelas','nota_test_drive'].includes(kpi) ? Number(value).toFixed(2).replace('.',',') : `${Number(value).toFixed(2).replace('.',',')}%`;
  const add = (a,b) => { const n=Math.max(a?.length||0,b?.length||0); return Array.from({length:n},(_,i)=>Number(a?.[i]||0)+Number(b?.[i]||0)); };
  const mergeStats = list => list.reduce((o,st)=>{
    if(!st)return o;
    ['nps_geral','nps_comp1','nps_comp2','estrelas','nota_test_drive','taxa_test_drive','taxa_retorno','q1','q2','q3','funil','dq'].forEach(k=>o[k]=add(o[k]||[],st[k]||[]));
    o.quantidade=(o.quantidade||0)+(st.quantidade||0); o.emails_enviados=(o.emails_enviados||0)+(st.emails_enviados||0); return o;
  },{quantidade:0,emails_enviados:0});
  const calc=(channel,st)=>{
    const nps=k=>{const [p,d,t]=st[k]||[0,0,0];return t?(p-d)/t*100:null};
    const bin=k=>{const [y,n]=st[k]||[0,0];return y+n?y/(y+n)*100:null};
    const avg=k=>{const [sum,n]=st[k]||[0,0];return n?sum/n:null};
    const a=nps('nps_geral'),b=nps('nps_comp1'),c=nps('nps_comp2');
    return {nps_index:[a,b,c].every(v=>v!=null)?a*.5+b*.25+c*.25:null,nps_geral:a,nps_comp1:b,nps_comp2:c,estrelas:avg('estrelas'),taxa_test_drive:channel==='vn'?bin('taxa_test_drive'):null,nota_test_drive:channel==='vn'?avg('nota_test_drive'):null,taxa_retorno:bin('taxa_retorno'),quantidade_retorno:Number((st.taxa_retorno||[])[0]||0),taxa_resposta:(st.dq||[])[0]?(Number((st.funil||[])[0]||0)/st.dq[0]*100):null,data_quality:(st.dq||[])[1]?(st.dq[0]/st.dq[1]*100):null,emails_entregues:Number((st.dq||[])[0]||0),emails_enviados:st.emails_enviados||0,q1:bin('q1'),q2:bin('q2'),q3:channel==='vn'?bin('q3'):null,quantidade:st.quantidade||0};
  };
  const monthStats=(dealer,channel,keys)=>mergeStats(keys.map(k=>dealer.canais?.[channel]?.monthly?.[k]));
  const values=(dealer,channel,keys)=>calc(channel,monthStats(dealer,channel,keys));
  const d1Values=(dealer,channel)=>calc(channel,dealer.canais?.[channel]?.d1||{});
  const objectiveClass=(channel,kpi,value)=>{const meta=D.canais?.[channel]||{},obj=meta.objetivos?.[kpi];if(value==null||obj==null)return'neutral';return(meta.menor_melhor||[]).includes(kpi)?(value<=obj?'good':'bad'):(value>=obj?'good':'bad')};
  const tableText = table => {
    const grid=[];
